slides.title: What is the Internet & WWW? 🌐
slides.text: A computer network links computers together. The Internet is the world's largest network! The WWW (World Wide Web) is the massive library of websites that runs on the Internet.
slides.spoken: A computer network links computers together. The Internet is the world's largest network! The World Wide Web is the massive library of websites that runs on the Internet.

slides.title: ISP, URL, and HTTP 📡
slides.text: An ISP (like Jio, Airtel, or BSNL) gives you Internet access. A URL is a web address like https://www.india.gov.in. HTTP is the rule protocol for sending web pages!
slides.spoken: An ISP like Jio or Airtel gives you Internet access. A URL is a web address. HTTP is the rule protocol for sending web pages!

slides.title: The Magic Modem ⚡
slides.text: A modem is a device that converts digital computer signals into signals that can travel over telephone or fibre-optic cables, and back again!
slides.spoken: A modem is a device that converts digital computer signals into signals that can travel over telephone or fibre-optic cables, and back again!

slides.title: Search Engines & Keywords 🔍
slides.text: A search engine like Google helps you find web pages. Instead of a long sentence, type short, important words called keywords, like 'Bengal tiger India'!
slides.spoken: A search engine like Google helps you find web pages. Instead of a long sentence, type short, important words called keywords!

slides.title: Web Browser Components 🗂️
slides.text: Browsers have title bars, address bars for URLs, tabs to keep multiple pages open, bookmarks for saved shortcuts, history to see past visits, and refresh buttons!
slides.spoken: Browsers have title bars, address bars for URLs, tabs for multiple pages, bookmarks for saved shortcuts, and history!

challenges.question: What is the INTERNET?
challenges.answer: The world's largest computer network connecting millions of computers globally
options: The world's largest computer network connecting millions of computers globally
A single computer in a school lab
A type of computer game software
challenges.hint: Think: is it one computer or millions connected worldwide?
challenges.misconception: The Internet is NOT just one computer or a game! It is the world's largest computer network that links millions of computers across the entire globe!

challenges.question: Drag each Internet term to its correct definition!
challenges.hint: Match ISP to company, WWW to websites, URL to address, HTTP to protocol, and Modem to signal converter!
challenges.misconception: Remember: ISP is the provider company (Jio/Airtel), WWW is the web library, URL is the address, HTTP is the transfer protocol, and Modem converts signals!

challenges.question: What does an ISP (Internet Service Provider) do?
challenges.answer: Gives people and organisations access to the Internet
options: Gives people and organisations access to the Internet
Makes computer hardware and keyboards
Creates and designs individual web pages
challenges.hint: Think: companies like Jio and Airtel provide what service to your house?
challenges.misconception: An ISP does NOT manufacture hardware or write web pages! An ISP is a company like Jio, Airtel, or BSNL that gives you an account and access to the Internet.

challenges.hint: Think about what you really do when you search: open browser, type keywords, press Enter, read results!
challenges.misconception: The correct search flow: 1. Open browser -> 2. Go to search engine -> 3. Type keywords -> 4. Press Enter -> 5. Review results -> 6. Click relevant link!

easierVariant.hint: Take it slow. Start by opening the browser, then type keywords, press Enter, check results, and click!

challenges.question: What is a SEARCH ENGINE like Google?
challenges.answer: A tool that helps you find information on the Internet using keywords
options: A tool that helps you find information on the Internet using keywords
A piece of hardware that converts telephone signals
A printer that prints out web pages on paper
challenges.hint: Think: what do you use Google for when you have a school project?
challenges.misconception: A search engine is NOT a printer or modem! It is a special website program like Google that searches millions of pages and brings back matching results for your keywords.

challenges.question: What are BOOKMARKS in a web browser?
challenges.answer: Saved shortcuts to your favourite websites so you do not have to type the URL again
options: Saved shortcuts to your favourite websites so you do not have to type the URL again
A list of downloaded computer virus files
Printed paper copies of web pages
challenges.hint: Think: why do you click the star icon in a browser?
challenges.misconception: Bookmarks do NOT store viruses or print paper! They are saved shortcuts that remember website URLs so you can visit your favourite sites instantly with one click.
